included: One scrollable page with up to six content sections. Agree the sections around the information your customers need before design starts.
Layouts for phones, tablets and computers, so the same business information remains readable at each screen size.
Contact options: an enquiry form, or phone, email or WeChat buttons, selected around how you want customers to reach you.
Basic search settings: a page title, description and sharing image. These explain the page without promising a search position.
Launch on a domain and hosting account in your name. Account access and handover arrangements are agreed with you.
One round of revisions within the agreed scope. Bring the requested changes together so the review can address them clearly.
not_included: Domain registration and hosting fees are separate from the website build.
Copywriting and photography are not included in the basic scope; agree who prepares the text and images.
A second language is a separate scope, including the matching pages and their content.
Booking or payment connections are additional work; third-party platform fees are explained beforehand.
Long-term maintenance is not part of the basic build and needs an agreed arrangement or separate quote.

process.title: Understand the job
process.body: We discuss your business, audience, existing tools, budget and the problem you want to solve.

process.title: Agree the scope
process.body: You receive a written proposal covering the work, deliverables, schedule, costs and payment stages.

process.title: Design, build, review
process.body: Review layouts and working previews at agreed milestones. We confirm any change in scope before proceeding.

process.title: Launch & hand over
process.body: We check the agreed flows, help you launch and hand over accounts and guidance. Ongoing support is agreed with you.

en.description: Custom website design in Sydney, in English and Chinese. Basic one-page websites for individuals and sole traders from {price_one_page}; meet in Sydney or work online.
en.h1: Web design in Sydney: custom websites for small businesses
en.answer: We design and develop custom websites for Sydney small businesses, from a basic one-page site to multi-page websites with bookings, menus or ordering. Basic one-page websites for individuals and sole traders start from {price_one_page}; larger websites, apps and business tools are quoted in writing. Meet us in Sydney or work with us online, in English or Chinese.
for_items: Sydney sole traders and small businesses that need a website explaining their services, prices and how to book or enquire.
Restaurants, schools, clinics and service businesses whose customers need the same information in English and Chinese.
Owners who want to start with a basic one-page website and add pages, bookings or a second language later.

sections.title: Meet in Sydney, or work online
body: If you'd prefer to talk face to face, we can arrange a meeting in Sydney to go through your business, your customers and the pages you need. Projects can also run entirely online, by email and scheduled video calls. Either way, you talk directly with the people who design and develop your website, in English or Chinese.
Meetings are arranged in Sydney time, and you review layouts and working previews at agreed milestones before launch.

sections.title: Bilingual menus, bookings and enquiries
body: For restaurants, tutoring schools and clinics, customers often need the same practical information in English and Chinese: menus, prices, lesson or appointment times, and how to book. We organise that information so both audiences can act on it.
Booking or ordering connections use an established service you choose. Setup work and platform fees are explained before you decide.

sections.title: Start with one page, then grow
body: A basic one-page website can be a sensible first step: one scrollable page with up to six sections that explains what you do and how to reach you.
When you need more, we scope additional pages, a second language or a booking connection as separate work, so you only add what your business uses.

en.pricing_body: Basic one-page websites for individuals and sole traders start from {price_one_page}. Larger websites, apps and business tools are quoted in writing after a short conversation, before any work starts. Extra pages, languages, content preparation and connections change the work involved; we explain deliverables, payment stages and ongoing costs before you commit.

demos.shows: A concept we designed for a fictional yum cha restaurant set in Chatswood: bilingual menus, and steamer baskets that stack as visitors order.

A concept we designed for a fictional nail salon set in Chatswood: visitors design a set nail by nail.

en.cities_body: We work online with businesses across Australia and overseas. If you'd prefer to meet in person, we can arrange it in Sydney, Melbourne or Perth.

faq.q: How much does a website cost in Sydney?
faq.a: Basic one-page websites for individuals and sole traders start from {price_one_page}. Multi-page websites, bilingual pages, bookings and other connections are quoted in writing once we understand the scope.

faq.q: Can we meet in person in Sydney?
faq.a: Yes. If you'd prefer to meet face to face, we can arrange it in Sydney. Project discussions and reviews can also take place online.

faq.q: Do you build bilingual websites for Sydney businesses?
faq.a: Yes. We write English and Chinese for their readers and keep menus, prices and booking details consistent. A second language is scoped separately from the basic one-page price.

faq.q: Do you offer Xiaohongshu promotion in Sydney?
faq.a: Our Xiaohongshu creator campaigns currently focus on Melbourne. For Sydney businesses we design and build the website and its English and Chinese content.

faq.q: What should I prepare for a new website?
faq.a: Prepare your business name, services, service area, contact details, text and images, and tell us what is missing. We agree who prepares each item before the build starts.

faq.q: How long does a website take?
faq.a: Timing depends on the pages, features and content readiness; milestones are set out in the written proposal.

en.cta_title: Tell us about your Sydney business
en.cta_body: Share your business, the pages you need and whether you'd like to meet in Sydney or work online. We'll clarify the scope and prepare a written proposal.

sections.title: 双语菜单、预约与咨询
body: 对餐厅、补习学校和诊所来说，顾客常常需要用英文和中文看到同样的实用信息：菜单、价目、上课或预约时间，以及怎么预约。我们把这些信息整理清楚，让两种语言的顾客都能直接行动。
预约或点单接入使用你选择的成熟服务，设置工作与平台费用在决定前说明。

需要更多时，再把新增页面、第二种语言或预约接入作为单独工作确定范围，只加生意真正用得上的部分。
